userStories.title: credit_tracker.py -- per-run credit logging
userStories.description:
Current state: no credit tracking exists. run_pipeline.py burns Nansen credits with no visibility into how many per run or per day.

What to build: NEW file scripts/credit_tracker.py. This module provides two functions used by run_pipeline.py:

1. get_credits_remaining() -> int
   - Calls GET https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/account with header apikey: NANSEN_API_KEY
   - Returns credits_remaining from the JSON response (field already confirmed: {'plan': 'pro', 'credits_remaining': N})
   - On any error (network, 403, etc.), returns -1

2. log_credit_usage(run_id: str, credits_before: int, credits_after: int) -> None
   - Appends one line to data/credit_log.jsonl
   - Line format: {"ts": "<UTC ISO>", "run_id": "<run_id>", "credits_before": N, "credits_after": N, "credits_used": N}
   - If either value is -1 (API error), skips the log write
   - Creates data/ directory if it does not exist

Constraints:
- File lives at: businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/credit_tracker.py
- Uses standard library only: os, json, datetime, pathlib, urllib.request (no requests library)
- NANSEN_API_KEY loaded from os.environ['NANSEN_API_KEY']
- DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'data'

userStories.title: run_pipeline.py -- wrap run with credit before/after calls
userStories.description:
Current state: run_pipeline.py exists at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/run_pipeline.py. It has no credit tracking. It has a main() function and a run_id variable set near the top of main().

What to change: add credit tracking around the pipeline run.

1. Add import at top of file (after existing imports):
   from credit_tracker import get_credits_remaining, log_credit_usage

2. Near the start of main(), after run_id is set, add:
   credits_before = get_credits_remaining()

3. Near the end of main(), before the final summary print, add:

userStories.title: credit_tracker.py -- daily budget gate in run_pipeline.py
userStories.description:
Current state: credit_tracker.py exists with get_credits_remaining() and log_credit_usage(). run_pipeline.py calls both. No daily budget enforcement exists.

What to add to credit_tracker.py: a third function:

check_daily_budget(monthly_allowance: int = 10000) -> tuple[bool, str]:
  - Reads all lines from data/credit_log.jsonl
  - Sums credits_used for all entries where ts is today (UTC date matches)
  - daily_budget = (monthly_allowance * 0.40) / 30  (= 133 credits/day for 10k/month -- 60% reserved for exits, position checks, manual trades)
  - If today_used >= daily_budget:
      return False, f'Daily budget exceeded: {today_used:.0f} used today, budget={daily_budget:.0f}'
  - Otherwise:
      return True, f'Budget OK: {today_used:.0f}/{daily_budget:.0f} used today'
  - If credit_log.jsonl does not exist: return True, 'No log yet -- budget OK'
  - If a log line has credits_used field missing or negative: skip that line

What to add to run_pipeline.py: budget gate at start of main(), before credits_before call:
  ok, msg = check_daily_budget()
  print(f'[CREDITS] {msg}')
  if not ok:
      print('[PIPELINE] Daily credit budget exceeded -- skipping run.')
      return

Import check_daily_budget in the existing credit_tracker import line.

Constraints:
- Modify only credit_tracker.py and run_pipeline.py
- Do not change any other logic

userStories.title: daily_summary.py -- add credit burn section
userStories.description:
Current state: daily_summary.py exists at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/daily_summary.py. It generates a markdown summary report. It does NOT include any credit usage data.

What to add: a credit burn section to the report.

1. Add a new function get_credit_summary(data_dir: Path) -> dict:
   - Reads data/credit_log.jsonl (same data_dir as rest of script)
   - Returns:
     {
       'today_used': int,       # credits used today (UTC)
       'yesterday_used': int,   # credits used yesterday (UTC)
       'monthly_used': int,     # credits used this calendar month
       'monthly_budget': 4000,  # 40% of 10000 -- 60% reserved for exits/trades
       'budget_pct': float,     # monthly_used / 4000 * 100
       'avg_per_run': float,    # monthly_used / total runs this month (0 if no runs)
     }
   - If file does not exist or is empty: return all zeros

2. In generate_report(), after the existing sections, add a Credits section to the markdown output:
   ## Credits
   - Today: {today_used} used
   - Yesterday: {yesterday_used} used
   - This month: {monthly_used} / 4,000 budget ({budget_pct:.1f}%)
   - Avg per run: {avg_per_run:.1f}

Constraints:
- File: businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/daily_summary.py
- Do not change any other section of the report or any other function
- data_dir is already defined in the script as DATA_DIR = Path('data') -- use the same pattern
